notes.title: Relight The Dark 1.2 Update!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings stranger.[/b]

I'm thrilled to announce the latest update for Relight The Dark, bringing you a more immersive and chilling experience. Here's what's new in version 1.2.

[b]Update notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Modified some environments
[*] Added more dialogue
[*] Expanded the ending
[*] Changed title screen and icon
[/list]

Until next time, stranger.

notes.title: Relight The Dark is out NOW!
notes.content: Join a young girl's journey to escape her abusive mother in this chilling, unforgettable experience. Can you survive the darkness? 💀
